title: High Level Design (HLD) & Distributed Architectures (102 Case Studies)
description: 102 production-grade architecture case studies including URL Shortener, Twitter, Kafka, Uber, Netflix, Amazon, and distributed consensus.
outcomes: Design web-scale distributed systems like URL Shortener, Twitter, Uber, Kafka, and Netflix
Evaluate trade-offs between consistency, availability, latency, and throughput
Confidently ace Staff and Senior System Design interviews
prerequisites: Basic understanding of client-server architecture and databases
